win_model.doc: logit(team A wins) = sum_A s - sum_B s + syn(A) - syn(B) + sum_{a in A, b in B} mu(a,b); s[b] = global[b] + mode[b][mode] + map[b][map] + tier[b][tier] + tier_mode[b][tier][mode] (tier = the rank tier the draft is played at, default_tier if unknown); syn(T) = sum over pairs {i<j} in T of synergy[i,j] + synergy_mode[i,j,mode]; with lo=min(a,b), hi=max(a,b): M = matchup[lo,hi] + matchup_mode[lo,hi,mode], mu(a,b) = +M if a<b else -M. Pair lists are sparse [i, j, (mode,) value]; missing entries are 0.

pick_model.doc: score(b) = log_base[b][map] + alpha*sum_allies lift + beta*sum_enemies lift; softmax over available brawlers. Lifts are symmetric, sparse [i, j, value] with i<j; missing = 0.

ranking.doc: rank our candidates by gain - kappa * strength_sd[tier][b][map] + gamma * log_base[b][map] (the pick model's tier-aware log pick rate) + rho * pro.log_pick[b][map]; reported win chances never include this. Ban suggestions rank by win gain + ban_lambda * pro.ban[b][map].

pro.doc: Pro esports drafts (Liquipedia, CC-BY-SA) from `since` to `until`, recency weighted. log_pick[b][map]: log share of pro team slots; ban[b][map]: share of pro maps where b was banned. Both shrunk toward the mode's pro rate, then Masters (picks) or all pro maps (bans). n_map: weighted pro maps behind each map's own rate.
